The '''Imperial''' was an elite [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] located aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] on its [[Bazaar Deck]]. It was styled after the audience chamber in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]], and the meals were lavish and expensive. A standard meal for two cost around two hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], with the house specialities costing more. The [[Bivoli Tempari]] and the [[Lobster Bisellian]] were two of the house specials.
